headline: Stonecradle Front Reignites as Linn of Mercy Clashes Intensify
war_summary: Since the previous edition, the tactical picture has shifted as Stonecradle abruptly reignited, recording seven rapid base transitions over the past two hours centered on The Dais and The Reach. Linn of Mercy continues its ferocious struggle unabated, logging six fresh redoubt exchanges alongside nearly thirty-four hundred casualties in two hours around Lathair and Outwich Ranch. Weathered Expanse sustains high friction with five recent base shifts across Spirit Watch and Crow's Nest under unrelenting fire. Along the coastlines, Stlican Shelf broke into action with three quick turnovers at Breaker Town, while Farranac Coast absorbed heavy losses during contested skirmishes at Transient Valley. Conversely, redoubt exchanges in Palantine Berm and Marban Hollow have slowed over the immediate two-hour window, though localized casualty rates across both central sectors remain substantial.
